title: コーポレートファイナンス
subtitle: Corporate Finance
teachers:
HIRATA Kazufumi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning and educational goal of the Department of Management Systems.
The goal is for the student to understand the basic concepts and methods of finance necessary for corporate management and to develop the ability to analyze and examine specific examples of corporate finance.
It also aims to understand typical Fintech services.
advice: In this course, students will first learn the basic concepts that serve as the premise of learning. They will then learn the basic ideas and specific methods related to finance.
requiredKnowledge:
This course deals with financial management from a capital procurement perspective.
In order to understand the content of this class, the material you have learned in previous financial courses will be useful, so it is recommended that you thoroughly review it before attending class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the role of financial markets and financial institutions.
Be able to understand financial management systems.
Be able to understand the time value of money.
Be able to understand various finance methods.
Be able to understand the cost of capital.
Be able to understand the optimal capital structure.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・Be able to understand the role of financial markets and institutions and explain the money creation system.
・Be able to explain the financial management system from the aspect of capital procurement/operation management and profit/cash management.
・Be able to understand the significance of the time value of money and calculate it in detail.
・Be able to understand the concept of weighted average cost of capital and calculate it in detail.
・Be able to explain the advantages and disadvantages of various finance methods.
・Be able to give your opinion on the optimal capital structure.
achievementLevels.standard:
・Be able to understand the role of financial markets and financial institutions.
・Be able to briefly explain the financial management system.
・Be able to understand the time value of money
・Be able to understand the concept of capital cost
・Be able to determine what kind of capital procurement is available.
・Be able to understand the basic idea of optimal capital structure.
